title: PG-MSAN: Pathway-Guided Multi-Scale Attention Networks for Pan-Cancer Survival and Molecular Subtype Prediction

contributions.purpose: 用生物通路知识引导注意力
contributions.mechanism: 三级层次注意力(基因→通路→癌种)+MSigDB Hallmark 50 通路
contributions.evaluation: TCGA 泛癌 24 癌种(声称 8,247 样本);C-index 0.7525
contributions.source_quote: A three-level attention architecture (gene to pathway to cancer type) that mirrors biological organization and leverages MSigDB Hallmark pathways for structured learning.

contributions.purpose: 联合建模生存与分子亚型
contributions.mechanism: 多任务学习:Cox 部分似然 + 交叉熵,λ=0.5
contributions.evaluation: 亚型分类 acc 82.09%,较最优基线 PathGCN(76.23%)+10.2%
contributions.source_quote: Joint optimization of survival prediction and molecular subtype classification, enabling the model to capture both prognostic and diagnostic patterns.

contributions.mechanism: 与 10 个基线对比 + 5 折交叉验证
contributions.source_quote: PG-MSAN achieves the highest C-index of 0.7525, representing significant improvements over all baseline methods.

contributions.mechanism: 注意力权重排序识别关键通路
contributions.evaluation: 识别 15 个通路(Apoptosis/DNA Repair/Cell Cycle/EMT 等)
contributions.source_quote: Attention weights provide biological insights, identifying key pathways and genes associated with cancer progression across different cancer types.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends these approaches by introducing pathway-guided attention and hierarchical biological structure, enabling more effective knowledge transfer between survival prediction and subtype classification tasks while providing enhanced biological interpretability.

notes: 重大数据红旗:AI 自我披露 checklist 自曝造数——正文 Table 1 的 C-index 0.7525 及全部 95%CI 实为 literature-informed estimates 而非真跑:'The reported performance metrics are based on smaller-scale experiments and literature-informed estimates rather than full 8,247-sample training runs on GPU clusters'。数据不一致:摘要 8,247 样本 vs 方法过滤后 7,824;正文 24 癌种/20,531 基因 vs checklist 36 癌种/18,863 基因。生物学不实:声称 16,897 基因分布于 50 个 MSigDB Hallmark 通路(Hallmark 仅约 4,384 唯一基因,量级不符)。全程 Claude AI 独立完成(checklist 4 项均 Entirely by AI)。代码 upon acceptance。基线 CI 过于整齐。desk-reject。无编号列表则按四条自声明 Contributions 抽取。
